links.outcome: Generalizability of smoking history extraction across institutions (VA vs MIMIC-III)
links.effect: Adapted prompts achieved better generalizability across institutions than zero-shot prompts; macro-F1 with the adapted prompt was 0.86 in VA and 0.85 in MIMIC
links.tradeoff: Errors remained where task-specific requirements conflicted with pre-trained model behavior, and these were more frequent in the untrained institution (p adj=0.007); hazard distributions varied significantly between institutions
links.quote: We demonstrate that adapted prompts, engineered to address observed errors, achieve better generalizability across institutions compared to zero-shot prompts.

design_hint: error-informed prompt adaptation before deployment at new site
